description: This file defines the PrepareBodyMiddleware class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, responsible for preparing HTTP requests with appropriate headers such as Content-Length, Content-Type, and Expect. It manages request modifications based on body size and protocol version.

classes.name: PrepareBodyMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that prepares HTTP requests by adding necessary headers based on request content and protocol.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next handler callable.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to process the request, adding headers as needed.

methods.name: addExpectHeader
methods.description: Private method to determine and add the Expect header based on request and options.
